Recorded claim:
tb-tools D320330 review history records the final recommendation for commit `0fc734e88d8483d3d9f44de2f8ee236b69febd4c`: remove TreeView's primary-button `mousedown` override and restore BaseTreeView's mousedown delegation. `_updateCurrentIndexClasses()` derives `aria-activedescendant` from `currentIndex`; a pre-click update on twisty, checkbox, delete, flag, unread, or spam paths can desynchronize managed focus from current/selected row. Focused `browser_treeView.js` was blocked before execution by `CLOBBER`; lint (0 problems), `node --check`, and `git diff --check` passed, while CodeRabbit timed out inconclusively. This is recorded patch-update context, not independently revalidated source evidence. [ad-hoc note]
